rubric: A real-looking name with address, identity number and payment details: personal_data.

criteria.exposure: a real person's name together with contact, address, identity or payment details; synthetic or placeholder data is none

reading.why: A name with a street address, a CPF identity number and card details reads as a real person's personal data.

ruledOut.question: exposure
ruledOut.label: none
ruledOut.why: A real-looking person with address, identity and payment details. It is not: nothing sensitive: ordinary interface text, and synthetic or placeholder data (names like Jane Doe, addresses at example.com, obviously fake numbers).

ruledOut.question: exposure
ruledOut.label: credential
ruledOut.why: A real-looking person with address, identity and payment details. It is not: a password, an API key, a token or a connection string shown in full.
